description: This file declares the interface for the MediaKeysCapabilitiesModuleService and its factory within the Rialto media server IPC layer. It includes class definitions, method signatures for handling client connections and querying supported key systems, and references external dependencies such as ICdmService and protobuf message types.

classes.name: MediaKeysCapabilitiesModuleServiceFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating instances of MediaKeysCapabilitiesModuleService.

classes.name: MediaKeysCapabilitiesModuleService
classes.description: Implements the IMediaKeysCapabilitiesModuleService interface, managing client connections and key system queries.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates and returns a shared pointer to a new MediaKeysCapabilitiesModuleService instance.

methods.name: MediaKeysCapabilitiesModuleService
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the service with a reference to ICdmService.

methods.name: supportsKeySystem
methods.description: Checks if a specific key system is supported.

methods.name: getSupportedKeySystemVersion
methods.description: Retrieves the version of a supported key system.
